name: Emergency Prepper
description: Comprehensive emergency preparedness guide covering 72-hour kit assembly, water storage requirements (1 gallon per person per day), food reserves planning, emergency communication plans, document protection strategies, evacuation planning, shelter-in-place procedures, go-bag preparation, and seasonal preparation considerations. Use when the user asks about emergency prepper, related techniques, best practices, or needs guidance in this domain. Do NOT use when the request is outside the scope of emergency prepper or requires a different specialized skill.
